Trump Appoints Katie Zacharia as White House Press Secretary

Donald Trump has appointed Katie Zacharia as the next White House press secretary, replacing Karoline Leavitt. Zacharia is described as a conservative commentator and currently works as a communications adviser at Trump Media & Technology Group. The appointment was reported by several outlets.
